gapSummary.repoFinding: CVF has a tested benchmark-harness instrumentation module whose reports are type-locked to PROPOSAL_ONLY evidence with no consumer, PROPOSAL-ONLY performance thresholds, and a real repeated-trial provider-lane canary/certification mechanism scoped to provider availability only. No canonical closed loop maps task class -> configuration alternatives -> measured quality/cost/latency/risk -> selected operating point -> regression.

Initial routing (TPGR) is monotonic-escalation-only after dispatch; DelegationContract and AgentContinuityDelegationRecord define static delegation shape and authority flags. Two independent searches of the delegation contract module for reclaim/escalate/replaceExecutor/addReviewer symbols both returned zero matches; no runtime-topology-reallocation primitive or test exists.

certificationState/uatState schema and release-gate bundle exist, but the lifecycle guard's own field table marks state transitions doc-only proposal, and no generic positive/negative invocation, outcome/process grading, stochastic-repeat, or WITH/WITHOUT ablation owner was found across skills.

Review Cost standard and its own machine checker explicitly and self-declare that they never score semantic review quality, root-cause independence, or value delta; only process/compliance counters (invocation counts, quota usage, round escalation) are tracked, not a measured WITH/WITHOUT or accepted-contribution/total-execution ratio.

A worktree-fingerprint plus verifier-identity-digest receipt mechanism gives strong, tested stale-evidence rejection and exact-revision binding for GOVERNANCE EVIDENCE resume. Grant-level expiry/call-budget checks (fail-closed) cover a single provider/store call. Neither combines into a general external-side-effect resume contract: execution-resource budget exhaustion and re-observation/deduplication of already-performed external actions were not found as a named, tested mechanism.

Verification evidence is exact-revision-bound and fail-closed on identity mismatch (autorun receipt/fingerprint/digest layer), and a fixed REQUIRED_GATE_IDS set is fail-closed-enforced against every declared work-order gate graph (check_gate_to_role_closeability.py). This is stronger, more code-enforced coverage than a documentation-only gap would suggest. The remaining true gap is narrower than the handoff's framing: no mechanism computes the required verification set FROM the concrete change's affected files/contracts/dependency graph/historical failures; the mandatory set is a constant membership list plus dispatcher declaration, not a diff-impact-derived selection.
